expected_behavior: Compute default rate per district (loans with status indicating default / total loans), identify districts in the upper tail of the cross-district default-rate distribution, not districts exceeding an arbitrary cutoff like 0.2 or 20%.

intent: Accounts whose monthly transaction volume dropped sharply
failure_type: Decline detected by comparing two static time points instead of identifying a sustained multi-month drop

intent: Loans whose repayment pace is slowing
failure_type: Total payments or status used as proxy for repayment pace trend
expected_behavior: Compute repayment amount per loan per month from transactions, then identify loans where the monthly repayment amount shows a consistent decline over time — a slowing pace — rather than loans with low total payments or a non-current status.

intent: Suspicious cash withdrawal patterns
failure_type: Suspicious pattern inferred from arbitrary amount or frequency thresholds without a compliance policy definition
expected_behavior: Suspicion is a compliance concept requiring explicit policy definition (e.g., structuring thresholds, velocity rules). Any SQL using amount > 9000 or more than N withdrawals per day is applying heuristics, not an authoritative compliance rule grounded in the schema.

intent: Accounts at risk of default
failure_type: Default risk inferred from static balance thresholds or recent overdraft count without a risk scoring policy
expected_behavior: Default risk is a modeled concept requiring a defined risk policy (e.g., loan-to-value ratio, payment-to-income thresholds). Without such a policy in the schema, using WHERE balance < 0 OR overdrafts > N applies an ungrounded heuristic.

intent: VIP clients
failure_type: VIP status inferred from high balance or loan count without a formal VIP definition
expected_behavior: VIP classification requires a schema-defined policy. Using total balance > X or loans > N applies arbitrary cutoffs — a proper definition would combine multiple signals (assets, tenure, product usage) with defined thresholds.

intent: Clients with healthy financial profiles
failure_type: Financial health inferred from positive balance or no overdrafts without a multi-dimensional health framework
expected_behavior: Financial health is a composite concept requiring explicit criteria (positive balance, low debt-to-income, regular deposits, on-time repayments). Without a policy definition, filtering on balance > 0 alone is an incomplete approximation.

intent: Clients with highest financial dependency on loans
failure_type: Loan count used as proxy for dependency instead of loan-to-total-assets ratio
expected_behavior: Financial dependency should be measured by total outstanding loan amount relative to total account balance (a loan-to-assets ratio), not the raw number of loans. A client with one large loan may be more dependent than one with many small ones.

intent: Most profitable districts for the bank
failure_type: Profitability proxied by total loan volume or account count instead of interest income minus credit risk signals
expected_behavior: Bank profitability per district should reflect revenue signals (loan amounts × duration as an interest income proxy) minus risk signals (default rates), not total transaction volume or client count, which conflates activity with value.

intent: Accounts with the most active savings behavior
failure_type: Savings activity proxied by total credit transaction amount rather than net positive balance growth over time
expected_behavior: Savings behavior should reflect the net growth of account balance over time (consistent positive balance increments), not the total amount of credit transactions, which includes salary inflows and does not account for withdrawals.

intent: Clients who have both a loan and a credit card

intent: Total number of transactions per account

intent: Number of credit cards issued per card type

intent: Average loan amount per loan status

intent: Districts with more than 100 clients
failure_type: none

intent: Loans with duration of exactly 60 months
failure_type: none
expected_behavior: SELECT * FROM loan WHERE duration = 60. Exact equality filter on an explicit value — no semantic ambiguity.

intent: Accounts with the frequency set to monthly statement issuance

intent: Total credit and debit transaction amounts per account
failure_type: none
expected_behavior: SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type='credit' THEN amount END), SUM(CASE WHEN type='debit' THEN amount END) FROM trans GROUP BY account_id. Explicit conditional aggregation — no distributional inference.

intent: Clients who have a disposition of type owner

intent: Number of orders per account
